name: Advanced Addons for WooCommerce
author: Amr Elarabi

sections.description:
Advanced Addons for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin that allows you to add dynamic, customizable addons to your WooCommerce products. From text fields to color options and image selections, this plugin makes it easy to enhance the shopping experience.

Features:
– Add flexible, dynamic addons to WooCommerce products.
– Support for various addon types: text, image, color, and radio buttons.
– Dynamic pricing for addons, with tax support.
– Global addon management through WooCommerce settings.
– Easy-to-use admin interface for configuring addons.
– Fully customizable design using CSS variables.

Use Cases:
– Personalize products with custom messages or images.
– Offer additional options like product engraving or gift wrapping.
– Allow customers to select colors or styles dynamically.

sections.installation:
1. Download the Plugin:

    • Clone or download the plugin repository as a .zip file.

  2. Upload to WordPress:

    • Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard.
    • Click Upload Plugin and select the .zip file.

  3. Activate the Plugin:

    • After uploading, activate the plugin in the WordPress admin area.

  4. Configure Addons:

    • Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Product Addons to enable and configure global addon settings.
    • Add and manage product-specific addons via the product editing screen.
sections.faq:
How do I enable global addons?

Navigate to WooCommerce > Settings > Product Addons and enable the “Enable Addons Globally” option.

Can I customize the appearance of the addons?

Yes, you can customize the design using the provided CSS variables.

Does this plugin support tax calculations?

Yes, you can configure tax rates for addons using WooCommerce’s tax settings.
